description: This file defines a report for item-wise sales history in ERPNext, including functions for data retrieval, processing, and chart generation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns, data, and chart data for the report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles the report data based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on filters.

methods.name: get_customer_details
methods.description: Fetches customer details from the database.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Fetches item details from the database.

methods.name: get_sales_order_details
methods.description: Fetches sales order records matching filters.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data from the report data.
